title: Syncthing: free Dropbox alternative
caption:
Dropbox charges $9.99/month to sync your files. Syncthing does it for free 🔄

✅ Pick a folder, link another device, and changes show up on both
✅ Photos, music, work documents kept in step with live progress
✅ Data is encrypted in transit and never uploaded to a cloud
✅ No subscription, no storage fees

💻 Windows · Mac · Linux
ℹ️ Syncthing syncs directly between your own devices, so it isn't cloud storage: devices exchange files when they're online at the same time, and there's no copy waiting on a server. The official Android app was discontinued in 2024 and there's no official iPhone app. Dropbox's $9.99 is Plus (2 TB) billed yearly

Comment "SYNC" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
